classification_scope: The two exact old Game lighting/fixture JSONs are preserved historical render/QA context. Neither proves accepted Court lighting. Existing source/render recipes retain their old paths and hashes; a future rebuild must deliberately select this archived context or a newly reviewed successor.
guard_policy: The successor wrapper enforces the exact manifest001 pin, preservation of every other original protection, exactly one removed live guard, and guarded payload copies of both precise old JSONs. This is not a general exemption for Game files.
native_proof_docs_and_helper: No native-proof helper or native-proof report is a live protected input in manifest001. Any hashes for them in court/source_build_run001/INPUT_PINS.json belong to its unchanged historical observational Game inventory. That inventory is explicitly not a live current-state guard or a current-proof claim. No proof-specific guard was bypassed.
priority_game_correction: The parent authorized current Game optical correction and later real-capture proof successors separately. This package does not patch, validate, accept, or restore those live successors, and does not pin future live optical hashes.
